collections.title: Façades & Halls
collections.description: Buildings that made me stop and look up.

photos.alt: Vega walking across a wide stone square beneath an ornate palace façade with a mansard roof, under a clear blue sky.
Vega in a white bucket hat at a carved balustrade inside a gilded hall of arches, chandeliers and a painted ceiling.
Vega in a cap, holding a drink, looking across a crossing towards a domed stone building with columns and a clock.
Vega in a long lilac dress leaning on an iron railing in front of the rounded stone apse of a large church.
Vega in a lilac dress sitting on a green bench beneath a tall tree, between cream-coloured buildings and a street lamp.
Vega, carrying a penguin tote bag, studying a wall of pinned-up landscape images in a white room with a timber roof.
A selfie of Vega in a cap and dark jacket on a sunny street lined with pale stone buildings.
At night, Vega holds a fluffy blue plush toy up to her face in front of a dark iron gate.
A selfie of Vega in a cap and face mask, sitting with her knees up in a bright waiting area with rows of seats.
A young girl in a white dress and a small tiara sits on a pale studio backdrop, looking upwards.
